name: 22.QF2

origin.summary: Test 2 of the 2022 CrossFit Quarterfinals. The Quarterfinals sit between the worldwide Open and the Semifinals in the CrossFit Games season — a harder online stage for the top slice of Open finishers.

description: Three rounds of alternating pistols, GHD sit-ups, and muscle-ups.
